title: Key Facts Statement and APR
summary: For covered term loans, provide an understandable KFS before agreement; disclose APR, repayment schedule and charges. Check the lender category and sanction date.
scope: Commercial banks as defined in this direction; new retail/MSME term loans sanctioned from 2024-10-01. Other lenders require their applicable consolidated direction.

title: Penal charges
summary: For covered loans, penalties must be charges rather than extra penal interest. Penal charges must not be capitalised and their reason and amount must be disclosed.
scope: Commercial banks covered by this direction; fresh loans from 2024-04-01, existing transition 2024-06-30. Product exclusions apply.

title: Consent for non-credit products
summary: Non-credit products require borrower consent and explicit fee disclosure in the loan card. An insurance charge alone does not establish coercion.
scope: Microfinance lending by commercial banks covered by this direction; confirm whether insurance is credit-linked or a separate non-credit product.

title: Microfinance prepayment and overdue charges
summary: Microfinance loans have no prepayment charge; delayed-payment charges apply to overdue amounts rather than the whole loan.
scope: NBFC microfinance context. Confirm qualifying microfinance status and current lender-specific direction; do not infer eligibility from loan size alone.

title: Microfinance pricing transparency
summary: Microfinance lenders publish their minimum, maximum and average rates. RBI scrutiny of excessive pricing is not a universal numerical interest-rate cap.
scope: NBFC microfinance context; application threshold used by this project is only a review heuristic.
